description:
At River we are building the world's most trusted financial institution to empower people to take ownership of their financial lives through Bitcoin, the world's only incorruptible digital money. We believe in a future where every person will have bitcoin savings, and every business will have bitcoin on the balance sheet. We obsessively design and build delightful products that help our clients buy, sell, secure, and use Bitcoin.

We are looking for a Staff Platform Engineer to automate away anything that slows our engineers down. AI agents running in the cloud do a growing share of our engineering work. You'll build and run the platform they work on: secure environments, safe access to the tools and data they need, and fast paths from their code to production.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role that bridges our infrastructure and application teams. You'll set the technical direction for our engineering platform and work closely with company leadership. You'll write code in our application and our infrastructure alike, and own what you build in production. Our stack is Elixir, TypeScript, React, and Postgres, running on Kubernetes across Google Cloud and AWS.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the AI platform our entire company relies on: isolated environments, scoped access, and agent tools

  • Set the technical direction and roadmap for our engineering platform, and drive it across teams

  • Find what slows our engineers down, and automate it away

  • Own our build, test, and deployment pipelines, and make shipping fast, safe, and routine for engineers and agents alike

  • Keep our Postgres databases fast and healthy: performance tuning, upgrades, migrations, and data lifecycle

  • Load-test and profile our systems, and fix bottlenecks before clients feel them

  • Improve our observability tooling, so engineers and agents can find and fix problems quickly

  • Harden our software supply chain from source to production

  • Take part in on-call and lead the fix when something breaks

  • Raise the bar across engineering through standards, design reviews, and mentorship

What We Look For In You

  • 8+ years in software, platform, or infrastructure engineering

  • You build with AI agents every day, and have built tooling or infrastructure for them

  • You write production-quality code, both in applications and in infrastructure

  • Experience with CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure as code

  • Strong database fundamentals, ideally with Postgres in production

  • You treat engineers as your customers and build tools they choose to use

  • You have run production systems and know how to debug them under pressure

  • You have led platform or infrastructure work that changed how an entire engineering team ships

  • You drive outcomes across teams, fix problems at the root, and own them end to end

  • Clear communication with engineers, executives, and non-technical partners

Nice To Haves

  • Fintech experience

  • Experience with Elixir, Kubernetes, Terraform, Google Cloud, and AWS

  • Experience sandboxing untrusted code or running AI agents securely at scale

  • Interest in Bitcoin

Location & Salary

  • 100% remote option available within the USA, with offices in NYC and Columbus

  • Salary range between $200,000 - $250,000 based on skills and experience

  • Significant equity stock options

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Parental Leave separate from regular PTO policy

  • 401k

This role requires a background check.
